features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)

hardware: four AWS g6e.2xlarge (one L40S each) in us-east-2 via SkyPilot (infra/aws/sky_ctx3_head.yaml, sky_ctx3_worker.yaml; clusters prc-ctx3a-d); tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --device cuda, float32 with TF32 matrix products; two lanes per GPU; every run of this declaration on that hardware

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --fold design: the round-1/2 design fold exactly (seasonal fit partition 2025-02..06, 08, 09 without LIRF; October monitored; October predictions only)
protocol.decision: An item is GO when (a) its R2 at b = 0.5 is at least 0.05 points below ref32's R2 at b = 0.5, (b) its 4-seed standalone October non-LIRF RMSE is below ref32's, and (c) the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the proxy RMSE difference between the item's and ref32's tables at b = 0.5 lies below zero. GO items go to a separately declared development round; the routed item with the lowest R2 is the only routed one carried forward.
protocol.masking: training only: each fitted row with adsb_matched = 1 is drawn with probability p at every step (a generator of its own) and shown as an unmatched row: the 21 declared focal-flight ADS-B columns NaN (what every unmatched row carries) and adsb_matched 0; its label is unchanged. Neighbour (nb_*, sfc_*) columns and context tokens are unchanged. Prediction never masks. p = 1.0 masks every matched row at every step.
protocol.never_read: No run of this declaration predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or the ranking months.

readings.R1: October non-LIRF RMSE of each item's 4-seed mean; matched / unmatched; unmatched by airport
readings.R2: recipe proxy (tools/nn_design_report.RecipeProxy, all 183,761 October rows; LIRF rows at v9) of table = 0.25 committee + 0.75 net with net = (1 - b) P + b X, b in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}, as % RMSE against net = P. X = an item's 4-seed mean.

items.e40: X = e40 mean on every row
items.route_mask100: X = ref32 mean on matched rows, mask100_32 mean on the others
items.route_mask25: X = ref32 mean on rows with adsb_matched = 1, mask25_32 mean on the other rows
items.route_mask50: X = ref32 mean on matched rows, mask50_32 mean on the others

readings.pool: P = 0.5 x mean(ctx seeds 101-116) + 0.5 x mean(ctx_e24 seeds 117-132): their seasonal-fold October stop predictions (runs/adsb_ctx/ctx_s1xx/seasonal/stop_predictions.parquet; the same fit partition as the design fold), i.e. v28/v29's network table on October.

purpose: GPU sprint, second design batch (user: 'go ahead use the gpu'), declared after batch 1's result (docs/adsb_ctx3/README.md) and before any fit of these seeds. Batch 1 showed focal-ADS-B masking improving unmatched rows ~0.2% while costing matched rows 0.25-0.45%, and 32 epochs as the only GO. Questions: (1) does a masked network used ONLY on unmatched rows (matched rows keep the unmasked network) help, at p = 0.25, 0.5 or 1.0 (1.0 = a network that never sees any focal ADS-B input)? (2) do 40 epochs beat 32? All on the 32-epoch base, fresh seeds 5-8.

tokens.data/ctx/tokens_v1: round-1 build (K 128, [-60, +30] min, centre -15 min), rebuilt on the head node by tools/build_ctx_tokens.py and copied to the workers; content hashes must equal the local manifest on every node
